claims.match_notes: Occupation is not employer. Nine exact-name Army rows exist; only the exact private identifier selects this one. The Box 152 namesake remains separate.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies Mary J. Craig in Box 151 without a private identifier. The complete Army file has one exact-name Women's Army Corps auxiliary row, but a common name alone cannot establish that it is the indexed person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to identify Mary J. Craig and test the unassigned exact-name WAC candidate. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index prints Nelson Craig with a literal seven-digit value. It was not padded into an Army identifier. One exact-name Army private row remains an unassigned name-only candidate.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 and determine the identifier system represented by the printed seven-digit value before testing the exact-name Army candidate. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: This Box 152 Robert B. Craig row has no private identifier. Nine exact-name Army rows and a 1940 Rural Electrification Administration assistant-administrator lead cannot be assigned on name alone.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 152 for identifiers that can distinguish this person from the separate Box 151 namesake and test the Rural Electrification Administration lead. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked Box 151 index row and official Army merged file share the exact Robert B. Craig name and exact private identifier. The Army row dates entry as a private to 13 September 1943 and records civilian occupation code 019.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to establish the Army-to-OSS sequence and identify the mechanical-engineering employer, if documented. Keep the Box 152 namesake separate unless direct evidence proves duplication.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file share Roger P. Craig's exact full name and exact private identifier. The Army row dates entry as a private to 18 March 1944 and records civilian occupation code 006.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to establish the Army-to-OSS sequence and determine whether author, editor, or reporter applied and for which employer or publication.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file share William C. Craig's exact full name and exact private identifier. The matching record is one of twelve exact-name rows and dates entry as a private to 5 April 1943 with occupation code 447.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to establish the Army-to-OSS sequence and identify the photoengraving employer or publication, if documented.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Richard J. Craigo's exact private identifier selects an official Army row dated 8 December 1941 whose converted name reads CRA GO RICHARD J. The missing I is preserved as a conversion discrepancy rather than silently corrected.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 and the original Army card to confirm the name conversion, establish the Army-to-OSS sequence, and identify the broad managerial occupation's organization.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies Richard Craigue in Box 151 without an initial or private identifier. No exact-name Army row was found, and similar surname results lacked an OSS or personnel-file bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to identify Richard Craigue and determine whether the adjacent Richard J. Craigo row is related, variant, or a different person. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies Mary L. Crain in Box 151 without a private identifier. No exact-name Army row or reliable OSS-linked institutional or newspaper source was found.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to identify Mary L. Crain and establish her immediate pre-OSS affiliation and last civilian employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies Arvid H. Craker with a strict private identifier. The complete Army merged file returned neither the identifier nor an exact-name row; this incomplete-file non-hit is not negative proof.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 and other service records to resolve the indexed identifier, military status, and pre-OSS affiliation. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 97; complete Army exact-name comparison; CIA and current Library of Congress checks; exact-name OSS, WAC, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, institutional, newspaper, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Four newspaper pages identified other people or non-name uses. One exact-name WAC row lacks an identifier or second OSS bridge and remains unassigned.
research_attempts.research_notes: No authenticated NARA Catalog request was made. The Army nonselection and newspaper rejections are recorded rather than treated as proof of absence.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 151 and test the WAC candidate against personnel-file identifiers.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 97; literal seven-digit value; complete Army exact-name comparison; CIA and current Library of Congress checks; exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, institutional, newspaper, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The literal seven-digit value was never padded. The sole exact-name Army private/student row is name-only and lacks an OSS bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable employer or personnel-status source was found. No authenticated NARA Catalog request was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 151 to identify the value system and adjudicate the Army candidate.
